name: Documents
description: Shared notes for the {space}: session notes, handouts and plans. One person edits at a time and everyone reads along.
author: Coffee Pub

settings.label: Let several people type in a document at once
settings.help: Off: one person edits a document at a time, with Edit and Done. On: a document is simply editable by everyone who may edit, up to eight people at once. This is an early version: with it on, the text is saved only while one person is editing.
